# Cart/Editor State Map: Live Material Region Feature

Going-forward surface is `cart/editor/` throughout. `cart/hmsc-int/` is prior-era reference (e.g. `cart/hmsc-int/game/textures/shaders.ts`) and is not touched below.

## 1. Material spec catalog (`cart/editor/render3d/shaders/`)

### The drop-a-file → spec pipeline

**`cart/editor/render3d/shaders/build-shaders.ts`** — the folder sweep, run via `tools/v8cli cart/editor/render3d/shaders/build-shaders.ts`. It is the ONLY file that runs when a material is added/removed. Flow:

- Lists `materials/*.wgsl` (`listWgslFiles`, line 50), sorted.
- Parses each file's self-describing header (`parseMaterial`, line 87): required fields `@material @slug @name @board @variant-labels @kind @tags @author` (line 105). `@material` must equal the filename stem and the `fn` name (lines 110-112). `@kind` ∈ `surface|composition|gradient` (line 116). `@board` slug must exist in `boards.ts` (validated at line 290).
- Palette-slot extraction (`extractSlots`, line 222; `isColorTriple`, line 178): every color-looking `vec3f(r,g,b)` literal (all three components in [0,1], excluding all-0/all-1) is recorded as a named slot and rewritten to `mat_pal(slotIndex, vec3f(baked))`. Slot names are inferred from the code context (`slotNameAt`, line 196: accumulation-mix factor → nearest assignment target → `"color"`; mix-pairs become `low`/`high`, line 244). The `.wgsl` SOURCE stays pristine; injection is generation-time only (line 375).
- Stable id assignment (`assignIds`, line 139) against **`_generated/ids.json`** — an append-only `{fn, board, index}` table. A material keeps its `(board, index)` forever; new materials get the next free index within their board; deletions tombstone (never renumber). Moving a material between boards is a hard error (line 160).

**Emits two generated files:**
- `_generated/registry.ts` — `MATERIALS: RegistryMaterial[]` (fn/slug/name/board/boardIndex/materialId/variantLabels/kind/tags/author/**slots**), plus `FILL_BOARDS: FillBoard[]` (the FILL_BOARDS-shaped view). `MaterialSlot = { name: string; rgb: [number,number,number] }`.
- `_generated/dispatch.ts` — `export const FILL_FUNCS` = helpers.wgsl + the `MAT_PAL_WGSL` reader (build-shaders.ts line 267) + slot-rewritten material bodies + `fill_pick(material, board, uv, px, variant, seed)` dispatcher (line 358).

**`cart/editor/render3d/shaders/boards.ts`** — hand-owned 15-board taxonomy (`BOARDS`, line 13), each `{ index, letter, title, slug, seedCoef: [perMaterial, perVariant, offset] }`. `index` is `D[4]`. New boards blessed here first, not per-material.

### The ShaderSpec shape and the palette-slot data[] contract

**`cart/editor/render3d/shaders/index.ts`** exports `FILL_FUNCS` and `FILL_SHADER` (= `FILL_FUNCS + FILL_MAIN_SRC`). The `D[]` contract per material row: `[materialId, variant, seed, quality, board]` (unpacked in `fill_render`, line 35). The `mat_pal` reader (build-shaders.ts lines 270-277) reads the palette section: `D[base+5]` = provided slot count, `D[base+6 + i*3 ..]` = slot i RGB; with no palette it returns the baked constant (pixel-identical). `mat_data_base` is a `var<private>` so a packed thumbnail grid (`fill_grid`, index.ts line 64) reuses the same materials without leakage.

**`cart/editor/textures/shaders.ts`** — the ShaderSpec authoring layer:
- `ShaderSpec` interface (line 50): `{ id, label, group, blurb, shader, base: ShaderParam[], variants: ShaderVariant[], buildData(variantValue, base, overlay) => number[], slots?: MaterialSlot[] }`.
- `withPalette(data, palette)` (line 69): appends the palette section — `[...data.slice(0,5), palette.length, ...palette.flat()]`. This is the exact function the material-region feature would call to recolor a region live.
- `shaderSpec(id)` (line 468): resolves catalog + imported specs.
- `shaderGroups()` (line 478): shelves specs by purpose category for the browser rail.
- `fillSpec(b, materialId, m)` (line 364) builds each fill-board spec: default seed = `perMaterial*materialId + offset`; `buildData` returns `[materialId, variantValue, seed, grade, board]`; `slots` looked up from `SLOTS_BY_BOARD_MATERIAL` (line 269).
- Imported textures register via `registerImportedSpecs`/`importedSpecs` (lines 459-466).

### Adding a NEW material .wgsl (the mud.wgsl flow)

Author `materials/<fn>.wgsl` with the header block (see the working example **`materials/plasma_glass.wgsl`**: `@material plasma_glass`, `@board neon_surface`, `@kind surface`, then `fn plasma_glass(uv, px, variant, seed) -> vec3f`). Use an existing `@board` slug. Run build-shaders.ts. It assigns a stable id, extracts color literals into palette slots, and regenerates registry.ts + dispatch.ts — no other file changes. `mud` itself is a live binding: `groundFormula.ts` line 60 binds tile kind `mud` → `{ fn: 'mud', variant: 0 }`, and `GROUND_MATERIALS` (line 49) is `MATERIALS.filter(kind === 'surface')`.

### The plasma effect's WGSL

Lives ONCE at **`runtime/effects/Plasma.tsx`** (the `@reactjit/effects` package), NOT in cart. `cart/plasma.tsx` is a 13-line demo re-exporting it. The shader body is `PLASMA_WGSL` (Plasma.tsx line 27): a four-wave sine plasma reading `P[]` = `[primary.rgb(0-2), secondary.rgb(3-5), tertiary.rgb(6-8), drift(9), velocity(10), opacity(11)]`; it sums `v1..v4 = sin()` waves into `v`, then three phase-shifted color terms, returns `vec4f(col*opacity, opacity)`. Params type `PlasmaParams` (line 9): `{ colors:{primary,secondary,tertiary}, drift, velocity, opacity }`; `PLASMA_DEFAULTS` (line 19): magenta/cyan/yellow, drift 0.02, velocity 1.0, opacity 1.0. The `Plasma` component (line 56) packs `data` in the same order and renders `<Effect shader={PLASMA_WGSL} data={data} />`.

Note this plasma is a distinct pipeline from the fill-board `plasma_glass`/`plasma_rim`/`plasma_conduit` materials under `render3d/shaders/materials/`.

## 2. On-disk model packages

**`cart/editor/data/modelPackageStore.ts`** — the IO half (`modelPackage.ts` owns format/paths, stays pure). Uses `runtime/hooks/fs`. Directory = model NAME (`packageDirForName`), id stays the key inside `manifest.json`; store resolves id→dir by scanning manifests, cached in `dirById` (line 41). Subdirs: **`MODEL_PACKAGE_SUBDIRS = ['mesh', 'atlases', 'paints', 'shaders']`** (`modelPackage.ts` line 36).

Package structure:
- `manifest.json` — `ModelManifest` (`modelPackage.ts` line 42): id/name/kind/stage, `mesh:{viewerPath, viewerMeshRef}`, `atlases`, `paints`, `placeable`, `skeleton`, **`textureSlots?: ModelTextureSlot[]`** (line 70), **`lights?: LightRig[]`** (line 71).
- `mesh/base.blob` — interleaved verts (8 f32/vert, `__model_mesh_write` format).
- `mesh/doc.blob` + `mesh/parts.json` (via `meshDoc.ts`) — the editable DOCUMENT: verts + face groups + part ranges + **`faceMaterials`** (per-triangle slot index, `meshDoc.ts` line 35/250).
- `mesh/painted.blob` + `mesh/painted.json` — paint-space verts + docStamp.
- `mesh/editmesh.json` — authored parts.
- `atlases/base.png` + `atlases/base.paint.json` (`ModelBasePaint`, versions 1-4, `modelPackageStore.ts` line 264) + `atlases/raster-base.png` + `atlases/layout.stale.json`.
- Writers: `materializeModelPackage` (line 142), `materializePackageArtifacts` (line 177), `writeModelArtifacts` (line 618). Identity/placeable patchers preserve `textureSlots`/`lights` on re-save (line 146-153, `updateManifestPlaceable` line 403).

**Where a per-model "material regions" list would persist:** exactly parallel to `textureSlots` and `lights` — a new `materialRegions?` field on `ModelManifest` (`modelPackage.ts` line 42), mirrored in `ModelPackage` (`types.ts` line 384, alongside `textureSlots` line 413 / `lights` line 416), normalized by a `normalizeModelRegions` (pattern of `normalizeModelTextureSlots` / `normalizeModelLights`), preserved through `materializeModelPackage`'s merge-guard (line 146). Per-face membership already has a home: `faceMaterials` in `doc.blob` (`meshDoc.ts`) stores a slot index per triangle. A live region shader body/palette would ride `shaders/` subdir or a manifest field.

**Load into studio viewport / placed props:** `cart/editor/stage/ModelDocumentSurface.tsx` reads the meshdoc → builds a viewer (`{ kind:'mesh', key, vertices, faceGroups, faceMaterials }`, line 295/168) and mounts `ModelView` (line 211-212). Placed props go through `cart/editor/world/livePush.ts`: `compileTextureSlotMesh(vertices, doc.faceMaterials, doc.faceGroups, textureSlots)` (line 103), skin boxes (`pieceSkinBoxes`, line 195), mesh-prop refs with per-slot `roleMaterials` (line 208), and lights (line 185).

## 3. Face selection in the mesh editor

Selection state is held HOST-SIDE (engine.zig — welded topology, selection sets), read back through host doors. React mirrors only mode + counts:

- `cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx`: `selMode` useState (line 725) — `0 view · 1 vertex · 2 edge · 3 face` (comment line 95). `SelInfo`/`adoptHostSelection` (line 1063) reads back `{mode, verts, edges, sel}`. `ModelToolSnapshot` (line 110) carries `sel` count out.
- "Select faces" produces **face indices** (render-face order). UV selection read via `readUvSelection` (line 1157) → `__model_uv_selection_read` → `{ islands: number[], faces: number[] }`, stored in the UV bridge as `selectedIslands`/`selectedFaces` (line 1218). `ModelFocusBridge.selectedFaces: number[]` (line 125).

**Pure model-side helpers** (`cart/editor/model/editMesh.ts`): faces reference a slot by `EditMeshFace.material` = index into `mesh.slots` (line 34, `TextureSlot` line 161). `assignFacesToSlot(m, faces, id)` sets each face's `material` (line 2615); `clearFaceSlot` (line 2624); `facesInSlot` (line 2643); `addTextureSlot(m, label, faces?)` (line 2606); `removeSlot` re-keys (line 2660).

**Existing "select faces and apply X" flows:**
- Texture-role creation from selection: `cart/editor/model/modelTextureSlotAuthoring.ts` `createTextureSlotFromSelection` (line 33), called from `cart/editor/inspector/RigSection.tsx` `addTextureSlot` (line 108) / `assignTextureSlot` (line 133) — both drive host door `__mesh_texture_slot_assign(index)` (line 110/134), which assigns the current face selection and returns the count. This is the closest existing template for "select faces → apply a material region."
- Paint fill (`ModelView.tsx`): `fillFaceAt` → `__model_paint_at` floods the whole hit face (line 621); brush → `__model_paint_stamp` (line 626); `brushTool` ∈ `'fill'|'brush'` (line 801).
- UV stacking (recent commits `5229567a0`, `d336fec11`): `cart/editor/model/uvLayout.ts` `stackUvIslands` (added at line ~723) overlaps selected islands onto the active island's footprint so stacked faces sample the same atlas pixels WITHOUT joining topology; `uvFaceCornerIdentityMarkers` + `uvCornerIdentityColor` mark shared welded-vertex identity. Called from `cart/editor/inspector/UvEditor.tsx` (line 534 stack, line 614/1107 identity markers). `UvIslandTriangle.vertices` (welded 3D vertex identity per corner) was added to support it.

## 4. Lights on models

**`cart/editor/model/editMesh.ts`** — `LightRig` type (line 138): `{ id, kind:'point'|'spot', position:V3, dir?:V3, color:hex, intensity, range, spread?, castsShadow? }`. Stored on `EditMesh.lights` (line 133). Pure editors: `addLight` (line 238, defaults to downward white spot), `updateLight` (line 254), `removeLight` (line 260), `nextLightName` (line 231); `cloneMesh`/`mirrorMesh` carry them (lines 195, 223).

**Authoring (rig mode):** `cart/editor/inspector/RigSection.tsx` — `addLight` (line 155), edit patch (line 164), remove (line 176), all through `onLightsChange`. UI at line 236 (add spotlight button), line 247 (per-light `spot`/`bulb` selector). Session draft lives in `state.modelLights[modelId]` (`types.ts` line 626); manifest `lights` is durable truth.

**Persistence:** `ModelPackage.lights` / `ModelManifest.lights` (`types.ts` line 416, `modelPackage.ts` line 71), normalized by `cart/editor/model/modelLights.ts` `normalizeModelLights` (used at `modelPackage.ts` lines 144/179).

**Emission into viewport:** `cart/editor/stage/Stage.tsx` line 154 selects `modelLights[id] ?? model.lights` → `ModelDocumentSurface.tsx` (`authoredLights`, line 126/191/211) → `cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx` line 2605: maps each `LightRig` to `<Scene3D.SpotLight ... cone={spread} castsShadow>` (line 2606) or `<Scene3D.PointLight>` (line 2617). Paint mode suppresses rig emitters (line 2605). Placed props: `livePush.ts` line 179-189 pushes `__compiled_world_set_live_lights` via `placeModelLight` + `encodeLiveLights`.

## 5. The editor's 3D viewport(s)

**`cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx`** (3456 lines) is THE component that renders the model being edited — mounted by `cart/editor/stage/ModelDocumentSurface.tsx` (line 211-212), one branch for a file path, one for an in-memory `initialMesh` (`{key, vertices, faceGroups, faceMaterials}`). It renders `<Scene3D>` (line 2579) with `<Scene3D.Camera orbit>`, the ambient/directional light rig (lines 2597-2601), rig emitters (line 2605), and `<Scene3D.Mesh hostKey={model.key} material="#ffffff" />` (line 2627) — all color comes from the host per-face paint atlas. Wireframe/selMode-driven (line 2583). (There is no separate `StudioViewport`/`ModelViewport`; the Studio uses `ModelView`. `cart/editor/world/WorldViewport.tsx` is the map/world view.)

**Live preview of painted materials/regions:** painted color is the host atlas, edited live through `__model_paint_*` doors (`ModelView.tsx` line 621+) and re-read via `__model_atlas_read` (`modelPackageStore.ts` line 594). Shader "ink" bakes a spec's WGSL+params into a paint bucket the brush samples (`ModelView.tsx` line 1865, `__model_paint_material_*` line 1875). A live material region would preview by pushing its composed WGSL / palette the same way ground does (§6) — or by baking into the atlas via the existing paint-material doors.

## 6. Live-bound ground materials (the JS-composed-WGSL reference pattern)

**`cart/editor/render3d/groundFormula.ts`** is the canonical model for JS-composed WGSL pushed to the host:

- `composedFillFuncs()` (line 136) takes the generated `FILL_FUNCS` and rewrites it for the ground pipeline: strips the `@binding(1) D` declaration (line 150, the harness owns D), neutralizes `mat_pal`'s slot count to `let n = 0` so baked colors always win (ground's D stream carries cells, not a fill palette — line 151), and rewrites `U.time`→`S.time` (line 152, ground binds SceneUniforms as `S`). Each edit asserts its pattern so generator drift fails loud (lines 137-142).
- `editorGroundFormula()` (line 161) composes those funcs with hand-generated WGSL arrays (kind→material/board/variant/joint tables) and `fn hf_ground_rgb(uv) -> vec3f` (line 209), which decodes the D reference stream (layout v4 documented lines 19-30) and calls `fill_pick(mat, board, surfaceUv, ..., take, seed)` (line 286). Result is `EDITOR_GROUND_FORMULA` (line 431) — static WGSL compiled once per run.
- **Push mechanism:** `cart/editor/stage/mapPaint.ts` line 168: `mapSetGroundLook(EDITOR_GROUND_FORMULA, TILE_KIND_PALETTE, FLORA_KIND_PALETTE, zonePaletteOf(zones))` → host `__map_set_ground_look` (framework `gpu/3d.zig`). Material PICKS never rebuild the shader — they arrive as DATA via `mapSetTileBindings` (binding table `bindingsToFloats`/`floatsToBindings`, lines 91/104). This "formula static, picks are data" split (documented lines 155-160) is the exact pattern a live material region should follow: compose the region's WGSL from `FILL_FUNCS` once, push per-region material/palette selections as data.
